title: Create, edit, and manage scripts
description: Learn how the Quickque library, full-content search, selection, bulk actions, Trash, sorting, and custom order work.
body:
# Create, edit, and manage scripts

Quickque treats a script as a title plus an ordered list of sections. The current library also supports full-content search, selection and bulk actions, Trash, sorting, and a custom order. Those controls stay local to the browser origin or desktop app where you use them.

## Before you begin

- Open the library in Quickque.
- Keep a full backup before a large reorganization, moving scripts to Trash, or permanently deleting anything. Use **Settings & backups** → **Export Full Backup**; [Backup, restore, and migration](/guide/backup-restore/) explains the versioned JSON file.
- Remember that the library is local to this browser origin or desktop app. It is not synchronized between them.

## Steps

1. Select **New script** beside the Quickque heading to create a script. The new entry is **Untitled Script**, with **Section 1** ready to edit. If no script is selected, the editor also offers **Create Script**.

2. Edit the script title in the large title field. Quickque saves edits to the local library as you work.

3. Edit a section title and its text directly in the editor. Select **Add Section** for another beat. Each section has its own title and text area.

4. Reorder sections with the up and down controls in a section header. Use the trash control in that header to delete a section. Quickque keeps at least one section in a script.

5. Use the **Search all script content…** field in the library to filter live scripts by title, section title, or section content. Search is local and case-insensitive. In Trash, the field is **Search Trash…** and searches the deleted scripts there.

6. Select the sort control, initially labeled **Custom Order**, to choose **Newest First**, **Oldest First**, **Title A-Z**, **Title Z-A**, or **Custom Order**. The selected sort mode is saved with the library.

7. For **Custom Order**, clear the search field, then drag script rows or use an item's **Move Up** and **Move Down** actions. Reordering changes the saved custom order; it does not rewrite script text.

8. Select individual script checkboxes or **Select all shown**. With scripts selected, open **Actions** to **Export as TXT**, **Export as JSON**, or **Move to Trash** in one operation. Exporting selected scripts is not the same as **Export Full Backup**.

9. Open a script's options menu for **Rename**, **Duplicate**, **Export as TXT**, **Export as JSON**, or **Move to Trash**. A duplicate is titled with **(Copy)** and receives independent script and section identifiers; editing it does not edit the original.

10. Moving a script to Trash opens a confirmation such as **Move 1 script to Trash?**. Confirming removes it from Library but keeps it on this device. Open **Trash** to use **Restore to library** or **Delete permanently** in bulk, or **Restore** or **Delete Permanently** from an item's options menu. Permanent deletion is explicitly irreversible. Trash has no automatic expiry.

11. Select **Present** in the editor when the script is ready. The reader's section selector lets you navigate the saved section order without changing the library's script order.

![Quickque library in the browser preview](/images/library.webp)

*Browser preview only: this screenshot shows the library/editor labels and is not native-app evidence.*

## Expected result

The library shows **Library** and **Trash**, full-content search, selection checkboxes, bulk **Actions**, and the selected sorting label. The editor preserves your section order and text. Duplicate creates an independent copy. Move to Trash is recoverable; **Restore** returns a script to Library, while **Delete Permanently** removes a trashed script without a recovery path. A full backup includes live scripts, active selection, Trash, custom order, and sorting mode.

## Troubleshooting

- **Search returns No scripts found:** search includes script titles, section titles, and section text. Clear **Search all script content…** or **Search Trash…**, or change the words you are looking for.
- **I cannot reorder scripts:** choose **Custom Order** and clear the search field. Dragging and **Move Up**/**Move Down** are disabled while another sort mode or a filtered search is active.
- **I selected the wrong scripts:** use **Clear selection** or uncheck individual rows; **Select all shown** applies only to currently visible results.
- **A script disappeared after deletion:** it was likely moved to **Trash**, not permanently erased. Open **Trash** and choose **Restore**.
- **A duplicate changed the original:** check that you edited the copied library item, whose title ends in **(Copy)**. A duplicate has its own section IDs.
- **The title says Untitled Script:** select the title field and replace it; this is a normal initial value, not a failed save.
- **An error says the library could not be saved:** stop making destructive changes, keep the current data open, and retry only after the storage problem is understood. A failed library write keeps the previous durable library, Trash, selection, and sort state unchanged.
- **A script is present in one place but not another:** browser storage and Tauri app storage are separate. Use **Export Full Backup** and **Import Backup JSON** for migration rather than expecting automatic sync.
